Displacing surrounding coordinates to chase positive pair-kernel/RMS directions while shape_yy and joint_innovation_RMS_A move unfavorably (branch_adjusted:158/235/228; joint_diagnostics:2).
rationale: Retain the incumbent (D2_without_trajectory_static: pointcloud_delta_A=1.0, teacher_neighbors=4, no temporal blend, mixture_temperature=0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0 fixed). No registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage under the affinity-first objective. (1) The Analyst's strongest reproducible directions are pair_kernel_1.5-2.5 and joint internal/innovation RMS (branch_adjusted:86/87/240/241 q 0.019-0.081, same-sign 0.786-0.929; branch_adjusted:228/230/305/307 q 9.3e-5 to 9.7e-4), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope), so no permitted parameter (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) is connected to those observables. Editing a parameter on the basis of a diagnostic feature the formula does not contain would be treating a diagnostic as an independent force. (2) The permitted pointcloud_delta_A curvature is the robust delta in R=tau*logsumexp(log_pi-rho_delta(q)/tau); the supplied evidence gives no contrast that isolates delta, and the only distance-scale evidence (pair kernels, assignment RMS quantiles 0.446/0.863/1.050 A) is diagnostic, so a 0.5/1.0/2.0 change has no predicted numerical response direction. (3) teacher_neighbors is a count, not a bandwidth (teacher_modes count 28, assignment RMS quantiles; fixed temperatures immutable); the Analyst's own hypothesis 1 notes the pair-kernel term is not in the executing scalar, and joint_diagnostics:14 shows contrast is 0.787 internal versus 0.132 translation and 0.081 rotation, so narrowing or broadening the teacher set is not supported as a distance-bandwidth change. (4) A temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit would require a verified continuous salience; the landmark_00 curves fail the fidelity audit (curve_support selects only 24 of the audited curves; relative_node_RMSE 0.286-0.867, polynomial_accepted false, strong_sign_conflict_nodes 1-14; continuous:1/2/3/7/9 have 6-10 sign changes), so a time-conditioned rule is not validated over the window and a temporal derivative is not a coordinate gradient. (5) Opposing evidence predicts a concrete failure: shape_yy is negative and significant in raw and adjusted correlations with same-sign batch fraction 1.0 (branch_adjusted:158 q 0.0026; branch_adjusted:235 q 0.015), joint_innovation_RMS_A is negative (branch_adjusted:228), observed_child_score_gain is negative (joint_diagnostics:2, mean -0.036, q 1.8e-7), and turnover residuals are large and opposite to population rates (turnover:1/2 edge 4.545 vs residual -4.360; turnover:14/17/47 residuals 4.286-6.397). A coordinate edit that displaces surrounding coordinates to chase the positive pair-kernel/RMS directions would be expected to move shape_yy and joint RMS in the unfavorable direction without a demonstrated affinity gain, and coordinate graph change alone is not a failure mechanism. (6) Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available false; lineage_support 349 nodes <3 ancestors, 531 <6 of 700), and survival enrichment is weak and not significant after BH (survival_effects:0 q 0.120; survival_effects:100 q 0.302), so no survival-based edit is defensible. Retaining the incumbent is the evidence-supported choice; the decision would change if a registered edit were shown to act on the executing pointcloud scalar with a predicted numerical response and batch agreement, or if a validated continuous salience passed the curve-fidelity rule.
